# Akaora Technologies

Official website: https://www.akaoratechnologies.in/
Location: Shikarpur, Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh 203395, India.
Founder: Akshay Goyal.
Contact: akaoratechnologies@gmail.com, +91 97605 05628.

Akaora Technologies is an IT and software development company offering website and web app development, Android application development, Windows desktop software, ERP and CRM solutions, custom software integrations, and social media marketing.

## First-party products
- Akaora Inventory Standard: ₹4,999 one-time software and 2-inch thermal printer package; Windows, Android and Web access.
- Akaora Inventory Pro: ₹6,999 one-time software and 2-inch thermal printer package; Windows, Android and Web access.
- Akaora Barcode Studio, Akaora Meet, Akaora Messenger, Akaora Classroom, Akaora Workspace, and Akaora Student OS: Akaora software product initiatives; confirm availability with the company.

The company states it is MSME and business registered; public registration reference numbers are not provided on this website.
